title: GoImage
description:
You can Add, delete, and manage the image files added in IPFS through your account in GoImage.  GoImage is like an image drive to manage your image files in the decentralized storage platform IPFS.
For each account correspondingly there will be one profile that manages the files.
how_its_made:
We did the project in Angular and the contract is written in Solidity. We used IPFS to manage the image files. We deployed the contract in Rinkeby network.You can Add, delete, and manage the image files added in IPFS through your account in GoImage.  GoImage is like an image drive to manage your image files in the decentralized storage platform IPFS.

For each account correspondingly there will be one profile that manages the files.
